partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Selective inhibition of a causal disease gene
results.hypothesis: A chemical may treat a disease when it selectively decreases the activity or abundance of a gene asserted to cause the disease.
results.body: chemical -affects[causes, activity_or_abundance, decreased]-> causal gene -causes-> disease; chemical qualified gene degree <=50
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule links directional perturbation to a causal disease gene, but the graph does not establish whether decreased gene activity corrects or reproduces the disease mechanism.
results.trapi_notes: The path and edge qualifiers are TRAPI-expressible; the chemical degree constraint requires Cypher or post-processing.

results.name: Multi-gene inhibition within a disease-supported process
results.hypothesis: A selective chemical may treat a disease when it decreases multiple disease-associated genes participating in the same bounded-size biological process.
results.body: disease has 3-20 associated genes in a process; chemical decreases activity_or_abundance of >=2 of those genes; chemical qualified gene degree <=100
results.mechanism_rationale: Requires coherent multi-gene perturbation and suppresses hubs, but the graph does not establish whether decreasing those genes is corrective.
results.trapi_notes: The graph motif and qualifiers are TRAPI-expressible; cardinality and degree constraints require Cypher or post-processing.

results.name: Direct binding plus inhibition of a causal gene
results.hypothesis: A chemical may treat a disease when it both directly binds and decreases the activity or abundance of a causal disease gene.
results.body: chemical -directly_physically_interacts_with-> causal gene -causes-> disease; same chemical -affects[causes, activity_or_abundance, decreased]-> same gene; qualified gene degree <=50
results.mechanism_rationale: Requires target engagement, directional perturbation, and a causal disease link on the same gene, but lacks disease-mechanism direction.
results.trapi_notes: The parallel-edge motif and qualifiers are TRAPI-expressible; the degree constraint requires Cypher or post-processing.

results.name: Specific drug binding and inhibition without adverse evidence
results.hypothesis: Precision improves when the direct-binding and inhibition rule is restricted to drugs, specific MONDO diseases, and pairs without explicit adverse relations.
results.body: drug binds and decreases causal gene; qualified gene degree <=50; MONDO disease with 1-500 descendants; no has_side_effect, contraindicated_in, exacerbates_condition, or causes edge from drug to disease
results.mechanism_rationale: Retains the same target-level evidence while excluding broad disease hubs and explicit adverse relations, but causal direction remains unresolved.
results.trapi_notes: The positive and adverse graph patterns are TRAPI-expressible; degree and absence constraints require Cypher or post-processing.

results.name: Curated-effect specific drug mechanism
results.hypothesis: Requiring a curated SIGNOR perturbation edge further enriches the specific drug binding-and-inhibition rule.
results.body: R017 plus affects primary source infores:signor
results.mechanism_rationale: Uses curated directional perturbation, direct binding, disease causality, specificity, and adverse-edge exclusion, but not disease-mechanism direction.
results.trapi_notes: Positive, adverse, and provenance constraints can be represented in TRAPI only partly; degree and absence handling are easier in Cypher.

results.name: Low-fanout causal target mechanism
results.hypothesis: Restricting the causal target to genes linked to at most 12 diseases removes literature-derived disease hubs while retaining specific causal mechanisms.
results.body: R017 plus causal gene disease degree <=12
results.mechanism_rationale: Retains direct target engagement and directional perturbation with a specific causal gene-disease link, but cannot distinguish therapeutic inhibition from disease-producing loss of function.
results.trapi_notes: The positive and adverse patterns are TRAPI-expressible; causal-gene degree and absence constraints require Cypher or post-processing.

results.name: Causal target with disease-process corroboration
results.hypothesis: A direct inhibitory causal-target mechanism is more reliable when the same gene participates in a process independently supported by the disease's associated genes.
results.body: R017 plus disease -process support-> process <-involved_in- same causal target gene
results.mechanism_rationale: Adds nonlinear systems-level corroboration around the directly engaged target, but does not resolve whether the perturbation direction is therapeutic.
results.trapi_notes: The source graph motif is TRAPI-expressible; the derived process-support cardinality, degree, and absence constraints require post-processing or Cypher.

results.name: Independently associated causal target mechanism
results.hypothesis: A causal-target mechanism is more reliable when the same gene-disease pair also has a dedicated gene-associated-with-condition assertion.
results.mechanism_rationale: Adds an independent relation family supporting the exact target-disease pair, but does not resolve therapeutic direction.
results.trapi_notes: The positive motif is TRAPI-expressible; degree and adverse-edge absence constraints require post-processing or Cypher.

results.name: Clinical-stage causal target mechanism
results.hypothesis: A specific causal-target mechanism with matching clinical-trial evidence should strongly enrich for treatment relationships.
results.mechanism_rationale: Combines target-level evidence with graph-internal translational evidence, but the molecular perturbation is not proven corrective.
results.trapi_notes: The positive motif is TRAPI-expressible; degree and adverse-edge absence constraints require post-processing or Cypher.

results.name: Applied causal target mechanism
results.hypothesis: A specific causal-target mechanism with matching applied-to-treat evidence should be a high-precision treatment rule.
results.mechanism_rationale: Combines target-level evidence with graph-internal treatment-use evidence, but the latter is target-adjacent and molecular direction is unresolved.
results.trapi_notes: The positive motif is TRAPI-expressible; degree and adverse-edge absence constraints require post-processing or Cypher.

results.name: Low-fanout process-corroborated mechanism
results.hypothesis: Combining causal-target specificity with same-gene disease-process corroboration may remove both literature hubs and isolated causal assertions.
results.body: R019 plus disease -process support-> process <-involved_in- same causal target gene
results.mechanism_rationale: Uses two independent biological branches around the same directly engaged gene without treatment evidence, but therapeutic direction remains unresolved.
results.trapi_notes: The source graph motif is TRAPI-expressible; process-support cardinality, degree, and absence constraints require post-processing or Cypher.

results.name: Low-fanout independently associated mechanism
results.hypothesis: Combining causal-target specificity with a dedicated gene-condition association should isolate highly supported mechanisms.
results.mechanism_rationale: The graph pattern is highly specific, but its novel indapamide-long QT prediction exposes the missing gain-of-function versus loss-of-function constraint.
results.trapi_notes: The positive motif is TRAPI-expressible; causal-gene degree and adverse-edge absence constraints require post-processing or Cypher.

results.name: Independent clinical low-fanout mechanism
results.hypothesis: A specific causal-target mechanism plus an independently sourced clinical-trial assertion should retain validation hits while excluding disease-gene hubs and target-source leakage.
results.body: R022 plus causal gene disease degree <=12 and clinical-trial source infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials
results.mechanism_rationale: Combines specific target-level evidence with independent translational evidence, but still uses treatment-oriented evidence and lacks disease-mechanism direction.
results.trapi_notes: The positive motif and provenance are partly TRAPI-expressible; causal-gene degree and adverse-edge absence constraints require post-processing or Cypher.

results.name: Curated independent clinical mechanism
results.hypothesis: Requiring curated SIGNOR perturbation evidence within the independent clinical low-fanout rule may further improve precision.
results.body: R026 plus affects primary source infores:signor
results.mechanism_rationale: Combines curated target perturbation, causal specificity, and independent clinical evidence, but remains tiny and lacks disease-mechanism direction.
results.trapi_notes: The positive motif and provenance are partly TRAPI-expressible; degree and adverse-edge absence constraints require post-processing or Cypher.

results.name: Tight multi-gene inhibition in a compact disease process
results.hypothesis: Precision improves when a selective chemical decreases at least three disease-associated genes in a compact process.
results.body: disease has 3-10 associated genes in a process; chemical decreases activity_or_abundance of >=3; chemical qualified gene degree <=50
results.mechanism_rationale: This is a stricter, hub-resistant multi-target pathway perturbation, but the graph does not establish that decreasing the genes is corrective.
results.trapi_notes: The graph motif and qualifiers are TRAPI-expressible; cardinality and degree constraints require Cypher or post-processing.
